batting.name: V Kohli
batting.dismissal: c AD Mathews b M Kartik

batting.name: RV Uthappa
batting.dismissal: c WP Saha b AD Mathews

batting.name: RE van der Merwe
batting.dismissal: c BJ Hodge b AD Mathews

batting.name: BJ Hodge
batting.dismissal: c MK Pandey b RE van der Merwe

batting.name: MK Tiwary
batting.dismissal: c & b RE van der Merwe

batting.name: SC Ganguly
batting.dismissal: c EJG Morgan b P Kumar

balls.text: Lovely paddle sweep. He moved outside off stump, went down on his back knee and paddled it from outside off to fine-leg boundary.
on the pads, rolls away for a leg bye
full delivery just outside off, PK moves outside leg and tries to slice it to the off side but doesn't connect ..
even fuller, almost blockhole length, pushed down to long-on
Awesome hit. Full delivery around off, Kallis stayed still well inside the crease and smoked it really straight over the bowler and over everything!
around 130 kmph length delivery on middle and leg, Kallis doesn't time his slog acrsos the line and top edges it over midwicket
Another short delivery, PK this time moves outside leg and flat bats it to right of sweeper cover
bouncer outside off stump, PK can't connect with the upper cut and keeper collects
in swinging full delivery, driven to long-off
walks outside off stump, gets down on his knee and paddle-sweeps it to fine-leg boundary! 50 up
another full and straight delivery, pushed to long-on
full delivery, squeezed out for a single

Angelo is da Maan for KKR so far in this competition. He slips in a slower one around off stump and Van der Merwe slices the intended big hit to backward point where Hodge takes a good low tumbling catch
full length delivery around off stump, slammed straight to Ishant at long-off
stays back to force it to sweeper cover
walks down the track and goes for the lofted big hit but ends up nicking it behind the wicket. Angelooooo had pushed it wider to induce that edge
Thwack! Robin reaches out to lift the full delivery well outside off over extra cover ...

the slow bouncer outside off, no one has picked it well so far today, Robin too goes through very early with his pull shot and doesn't make contact. Angelo tumbles and falls to the ground post release
full and outside off stump, Robin hits it really hard , slapping square-drive, but finds the man at the deep cover
yorker length .. slightly slower, tails in late, jabbed away to the on side

walks down the track, high full toss, swatted away to the on side .. Uthappa checks with Dharmasena, the former Sri Lankan player and currently an umpire, whether it was above waist-high, and Dharmasena smiles!
cuts in from outside off, punched away to sweeper cover
slips to the legs and Kallis whips it to the deep midwicket boundary. He stayed outside leg, adjacent to the line and played the wristy shot wide of deep midwicket fielder
really full delivery, tailing in late, driven to long-off
around the off stump line, Kallis goes for the back-foot punchy drive but edges it uppishly just short of backward point
full in length, it appeared as if Robin was shaping for the slog sweep but changes his mind to push it to cover for a single
charges down the track, Rohan shortens the length, hit powerfully to right of long-on where Ishant makes a tumbling stop
square drives this one to point region
moves outside leg stump and lifts inside-out to extra-cover boundary
on the middle stump line, skids on to the middle, pushed out to point ..
whipped down to long-on. Just four runs from that over. Kartik's fine spell ends.
on a length around off, driven to left of short straight cover where Ganguly makes a diving stop. Crowd roar!
low dipping full toss, dips rapidly on Robin who makes contact with the bottom of the bat .. single to long-on
moves down the track to drive to long-on
just outside off stump, Kallis tries to square drive and misses it
on the middle and leg, pushed out to the on side for a single
length delivery around off stump, pushed out to right of backward point for a single
walks towards the off stump line and taps the slower one from around off to short fine-leg region
walks across to the off, taps the length delivery to the off side for a single
fullish on the off and middle stump line, Uthappa on drives it to right of long-on for couple of runs ..
cuts in to the middle stump line, stabbed to the off side for a quick single
on the middle and leg stump line, turned to fine-leg region
length delivery outside off, guided to backward point
forced away to deep point region where Cheteshwar pujara rushes across to cut it off
shuffle across to run this one down to third man
slower one outside off, full in length, dabbed down to third man
on the middle stump line, turned to right of midwicket for a single

Another fatal inside edge. Angelo strikes again. It was a low dipping full toss well outside off, Dravid wanted to lash it to the cover boundary but gets a thick inside edge as he perhaps went too hard at the ball. He is fuming as he walks back.
fuller, on the leg and middle stump line, Kallis flicks it away to the boundary
slower one, pulled away to deep midwicket for a single
plays it down to deep midwicket for a single
slower one, chipped over the on-side 30-yard circle
leans forward to punch to the off side for a single
stays back to punch the length delivery to Ishant at long-off
slower one, on a length around off, driven on the up to long-off
cuts in to the middle stump line, pushed out back down the track
bouncing short-of-length delivery straightening outside off and Dravid is beaten, trying to play a late cut through the vacant slip region
What a dreamy classy off drive. Gorgeous. Full pitched outside off stump and DRavid went down on a bent knee to play a lovely drive through extra cover.
slower one, from the good length this time, tapped to third man
the slow bouncer around off stump, Dravid is very early through his pull shot, misses but so does the keeper
quicker arm ball , Dravid presses back to punch it to long-on
full toss but Kallis drives straight to cover
around the middle and leg, drifting in, tapped to midwicket
skips down the track to drive it past the diving bowler for a single to long-on
around off stump line, turns away, steered to point
on the off stump line, pushed out to cover
slightly short in length on the middle stump line, Dravid unfurls the pull shot to collect a boundary
tapped behind the wicket on the off side for a single
back of length on the off stump line, punched down to long-on
length delivery around off stump, driven to long-off
length delivery tailing in on middle and leg,. wristed straight to midwicket
short in length, punched to deep point region
drifts towards the pads, nudged away
gets forward to on drive uppishly but safely past the straight midwicket fielder and down to long-on
Whack! It was a really full delivery on the middle and leg line, Dravid moved outside leg and played a classy whippy lofted hit to wide midwicket boundary
quicker one, skids on almost straight, punched to deep point.  No ball, though. Free hit coming up.
backs away to square drive to sweeper cover
Goes for the reverse sweep but Kartik had slowed up the pace and shortened the length .. Morgan was early through his shot and the ball bounded off his arm and fell on the stumps.
flicks it to short midwicket where Ganguly stops
around off stump line, cut away for a single
on the middle stump line, whipped to deep midwicket
leans forward to ease it to long-on
works this through the on side
Morgan sashays down the track and just nonchalantly lifts it over long-off. Lovely piece of timing there
flighted around off stump, pushed out to a diving Ganguly at short cover
slips this too much down the leg side and Kallis swings it to square-leg boundary
on the leg and middle line,d rifting away, turned to the on side

Murali Kartik, who  bowled superbly in the previous editions of iPL, takes out Kohli. He got it to dip rapidly on Kohli, who had charged down the track, and the attempted lofted hit went towards deep midwicket. Lovely bit of bowling from Kartik.
on the middle and leg, skids on with the arm, edged to square-leg
quicker, on the middle stump line, dabbed to the on side for a single
flighted delivery on the leg stump line, flicked away to deep midwicket
the slow bouncer and Kallis is early into the pull, tries to check his shot and swat it away but misses .. the ball bounds off his body ..
clips this to deep backward square-leg
length delivery cutting in, pushed out to mid-on

Inside edge .. dragged on! Manish looked tentative throughout his brief stay - perhaps the pressure of playing in Eden Gardens -  and is gone now. He tries to force a length delivery outside off .. he stays rooted to his crease, just lunges out and attempts to flat bat it. Fatal inside edge.
slower one on the middle stump line, turned behind square-leg
short in length and well outside off stump, cut away hard to left of point where its fielded
closer to the off stump, steered to point. Just a wide from that over from Ishant. pretty cool stuff.
in the zone outside off stump, Manish has a tentative poke at it and is beaten. Very good over so far.
probably he thought Manish would move down the leg side again and fired a short delivery just outside leg but Manish, who was shaping to move down leg, gets back inside ..
again Manish moves away at the last minute .. he almost waits for the ball to land before he backs away outside leg and again mistimes the punchy shot .. this time to mid-on
fuller, on the middle and leg, Manish almost hops out to the leg side to create room and flicks it away but can't beat midwicket fielder ... Ishant has a few things to say to the batsman
banged in short outside off stump ... Manish plays a very weak pull shot .. just a swat almost and the ball falls short of Rohan Gavaskar at mid-on
short and climbing outside off, jabs it away

the short deliveries haven't troubled Goswami but have kept him scoreless. He has found it difficult to pull or cut. This time he charged down the track and received a bouncer and he could only top edge the attempted cut straight to third man
superb lifting bouncer around middle stump, Sreevats sways away from the line of the ball
He moves outside leg again, Langeveldt bangs it short around off, mistimes the cut to cover
backs away outside leg stump and drags a back-of-length delivery from the off stump line over wide midwicket region
lifter on the middle stump line, Sreevats defends it back down the track
length delivery around off, Sreevats moves outside leg stump but can't get any power or timing behind the forcing shot .. the ball rolls towards mid-off
Kallis breaks free with a fierce lofted hit over covers. He took couple of steps down the track and went inside-out in style. Great to watch.
stays back to punch it to cover. Another dot ball.
walks down the track and across to outside-off but can't connect with a length delivery moving away from him
around the off stump line, tapped to the off side
homing in on the off stump, Kallis stays adjacent to the line and opens the bat-face to punch it neatly through point
in the zone outside off stump, holds its line, left alone
lifting delivery in the channel outside off stump, left alone
backs to the leg side, takes the risk, and slashes the length delivery off the outer edge to left of second slip - not all that far away from the fielder - to the boundary
short in length and moving across Sreevats who goes for the big swing over mid-on but doesn't connect
straightens on the middle stump line and Sreevats jabs it out at the last minute
length delivery shaping away from the off stump, run down to third man for a single.
short in length and outside off stump, Kallis gets across to push it out to cover
KKR win their second game in a row. Shah square drives the length delivery past point
full in length, pushed straight to mid-on .. dot ball.. Kumble is shouting instructions
slower one, outside off, run down to third man
tries to pull a length delivery from outside off stump, misses and is struck on the pad
shuffles across, the ball cuts in, gets past the poke and hits the pad outside off
charges down the track and edges the intended big hit to the on side
banged in short outside off stump, Ganguly pulls it but straight to deep midwicket fielder ...Oh well ...
short in length outside off, guided to backward point
lovely delivery, in the channel outside off stump and shaping away late and Pujara is beaten again, stabbing inside the line
fullish, hint of away swing outside off, square driven to point.
on the off stump line, defended to cover
length delivery shaping away from Pujab who is beaten pushing inside the line
The bouncer arrives, guided to third man
Dadaaaaaaaa! Take a bow. Stunningly fabulicious hit over long-off. He clears his front foot and lifts Steyn over long-off
from round the stumps, full in length, flicked past square-leg
full in length and outside off stump, goes for the drive but bottom  edges it along the ground to the keeper
clears the front foot and drags the length delivery to long=on boundary. Fiercely flat-batted hit.
Top edged over keeper ... Bounced in short and Ganguly tries to pull from outside off but doesn't connect well
length delivery outside off, driven to deep cover
length delivery around off stump, driven to cover
slower googly this time ... on driven to long-on
from a slightly round-armsih action . around off stump , Pujara rushed down the track to punch it to cover ..
around the off stump line, stabbed to the on side
turns from the off stump, pushed out to cover
top edges a sweep to short fine-leg region
on the off stump line, dabbed to the on side
leans forward to push to cover
full in length and outside off stump, steered to third man
length delivery around off stump line, punched sweetly to deep cover
on the middle and leg, worked through midwicket
short in length, punched away to deep point region
length delivery straightens outside off, beaten on a tentative poke
Hodge holes out to long-on. He moved down the track but was beaten in flight and ended up slicing it ... Fine innings from him
leans forward to squeeze it off bat and pad to point
leans forward to work it to midwicket
leans forward to ease it to long-on. . 50 for Hodgy
on the pads, rolls away to short fine-leg
full delivery on the middle stump line, driven to long-on
short in length, bounces even as it straightens, moves past the prod to run off the thigh pad
full in length around off stump line, Ganguly gets forward and across to square drive to deep point
around the off stump line, squeezed out to point
on the off stump line, pushed through point
around the off stump line, tapped to cover for a single
full in length, pushed to point
another bouncer.. very high this time and Ganguly ducks ...
bouncer that slides just down the leg side, Ganguly allows it to pass him
Dropped by Sreevats It turned in from outside off, Ganguly tried to run it through vacant slip region and edged it behind but Sreevats couldn't hold on to a tough chance
leans forward to defend to midwicket

Good catch by Van der Merwe. Tiwary had really struck it very hard back down the pitch .. Van der Merwe manages to hold on it .. it hit him on the wrist i think and rolled up and he clung on to it. Looks like he is in some pain now.. Entertaining breezy fifty from Tiwary.
moves outside leg , reaches out to a delivery outside off and carves it to deep point. 50 up for Tiwary
eases this one to long-on
Slam! He leaned forward, cleared the front foot and slog swept it to the midwicket boundary
slightly slower one, well outside off stump, steered to Kohli at backward point
backs away outside leg and cuts the sort of length to right of backward point where Kohli flies to make the half-stop
slower one, on the leg stump line, beats the intended swing across the line and is hit on the pad
Top-edged to fine-leg boundary. A bouncer from Steyn has Hodge going for the pull but he is late on the shot. Never mind, though .. he gets a lucky top edge
banged in short outside off stump, Hodge cuts it to the point boundary. Width offered and Hodge doesn't waste the opportunity
straight, fast and just outside off, Hodge tries to force it through the off side and is beaten
full length delivery on middle and leg, worked to deep midwicket
moves down the track but Kumble shortens the length and hodge edges it to his pad
full, almost yorker outside off, dug out .. edged to his pad
quicker length delivery outside off, mistimes the cut to point
works this to midwicket for a single
Ah! a fine paddle sweep. Tiwary  reached out to paddle away the googly to fine-leg boundary
on the off stump line, pushed out to Kumble at extra cover
slips it down the leg side ..
moves forward to on drive it wide of long-on fielder
rushes down the track and lifts it over the bowler and to the straight boundary
moves outside leg stump and punches it to deep cover
full delivery, swung to deep midwicket
backs away to drive to sweeper cover
slider ,moves past the defensive prod and hits the pad .. going down leg ..
And again. Good probing bowling and Hodge knows he can afford to play out these deliveries ,, doesn't have to take risks
on the middle and off line, quickish, defended on the front foot
really full delivery, worked to midwicket
full around off, driven to cover
flicked away for a single
on the middle stump line, swatted through to deep midwicket
on the off stump line, pushed to cover
on the middle and leg, wristed to midwicket
another one that slides down the leg side ..
goes for the sweep but doesn't connect properly
quickish, slides down leg side .. wide
on the leg stump line, dabbed to square-leg
drops it on the blockhole, dug out to the off side
slows up the pace, driven to cover
slider on the middle stump line, edged to the on side
stays beside the line of this full delivery and drives inside-out to extra cover where Kohli stops
Adrenalin rush! He fetched this from well outside off and drags it with a slog sweep to wide midwicket boundary.
Neat!  It was slightly short in length and outside off, Tiwary waits, reaches out, opens the bat-face and guides the ball past backward point ..
full in length, cut to point
Another classy drive. Full, straight and pacy, Hodgy leans forward to caress it through extra cover.
Shot! length delivery around off stump line, Hodge stays adjacent to the line to play a neat square drive to the boundary. He played it late and just used the pace of the ball
Tiwary moves outside leg, Steyn follows him with a really full delivery, dug out to mid-on
mistimes this one back to Steyn
Thunderous hit! Manoj Tiwary has just slammed Steyn over long-off. He moved outside off stump and lifted the full length delivery over the boundary. Eden Gardens erupts.
length delivery on the middle stump line, tapped to the on side
Thrash! Tiwary backs away to play a fabulous square drive. Crack of doom. Tiwary has exploded after the ankle injury
full in length, pushed back to the bowler who threatens to throw it back at the stumps. An unflustered Tiwary just watches on
BOsh! Kallis stares at Tiwary who simply looks at where the ball went .. it has sailed over midwicket. He fetched the full delivery from the off stump line and biffed it high over midwicket. Wallop!
He is still hobbling out there but that was a creamy square drive .. he sliced the full delivery to point boundary

comedy of errors and a run out missed. Hodge takes a forward step and drags a length delivery from off stump line to deep midwicket region. Tiwary has some ankle problem while turning for the second run and puts his hand up to Hodge that he doesn't want the third run.. Hodge doesn't see it and turns for the third run .. both end up on the same end .. Hodge says Tiwary to push on ..STeyn fires in a throw at the strikers' end .. Sreevats  Goswami gets an awkward bounce and doesn't collect it cleanly .. run out chance missed! Dravid collects and underarms the throw but by then it was too late
cuts in towards off stump line, defended to the off side
in the channel outside off, run down to third man
on the stumps, defended to the on side
around off stump line, tapped to midwicket for a single
full in length and curving away late, Tiwary is beaten, square driving away from the body
on the middle stump line, turned to midwicket for a single
Imperious. It was short in length around off and middle stump line, Hodge plays a nonchalant pull shot to deep backward square-leg boundary
on the middle stump line, turned past square-leg
slow off cutter, Hodge backs away to dab it to left of third man and they run hard to come back for the second
length delivery outside off, punched neatly on the up to left of cover where Manish dives to take pace off the ball
Crunchy pull shot. It was banged in short outside off and Tiwary waited before playing an peachy pull through midwicket
length delivery on the off stump line, pushed to the off side for a quick single
in the zone outside off stump, left alone
walks down the track again, this one cuts back in, clipped behind square-leg .. wide throw from Dale Steyn .. extra run
walks down the track, PK gets to curve it away superbly past the outside edge ...
on the middle stump line, tailing in, worked to deep backward square-leg
length delivery well outside off, Hodge reaches out to cut and bottom edges it along the ground to the keeper
length delivery around off stump, defended on the front foot
just outside off stump, steered to backward point. Hodge signals to the people to settle down behind the sightscreen
